events.verdict: Murray (DEN) establishes positive front court position within 8 seconds.
Jokic (DEN) places his forearm on Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) side as he defends alongside his path and marginal body contact occurs the driving shot attempt.
Hardaway Jr. (DEN) maintains a legal guarding position alongside Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) path and marginal body contact occurs as they come together.
Hartenstein (OKC) goes to, not through, Murray's (DEN) space as they come together during the pick, and the contact is marginal.
Jokic (DEN) and Hartenstein (OKC) mutually engage and disengage as marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
Hartenstein (OKC) brings his arm forward and marginal contact occurs with Jokic's (DEN) arm that does not effect his ability to gather at the end of his drive.
Jokic (DEN) applies his hand to Holmgren's (OKC) front off-ball, and the contact that occurs is marginal.
Braun (DEN) brings his arm toward Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) front and marginal contact occurs as they come together during the drive.
Braun (DEN) makes clean contact with the ball as he contests the jump shot attempt and avoids making contact with Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) arm.
Jokic (DEN) establishes himself in Caruso's (OKC) path prior to the contact.
Johnson (DEN) brings his right arm slightly forward as he contests Caruso's (OKC) shot attempt and the body contact that occurs is marginal.
Johnson (DEN) pulls Holmgren's (OKC) jersey away from his body and the contact affects Holmgren's ability to get to the pass.
Jokic (DEN) goes to, not through, Williams' (OKC) space and marginal contact occurs as the two come together in the post.
Holmgren (OKC) fails to fully clear the lane and is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Johnson (DEN) establishes a screening position in Williams' (OKC) path and marginal contact occurs to his side as he defends over the screen.
Joe (OKC) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Hardaway Jr. (DEN) prior to any incidental arm contact occurring.

Replay review of the foul called on Holmgren (OKC) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Holmgren (OKC) makes clean contact with the ball and absorbs the body contact that occurs as he jumps vertically to contest Braun's (DEN) layup attempt.
Wallace (OKC) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Johnson (DEN) reaches in and initiates illegal contact with Holmgren's (OKC) arm.
Murray (DEN) commits a take foul on Wallace (OKC).
Braun (DEN) commits a take foul on Wallace (OKC).
Murray (DEN) commits a take foul on Williams (OKC).
